articles.title: Genesis Championship: Yuto Katsuragawa takes two-shot lead into final day as he ties course record with flawless 63
articles.summary: Japan's Yuto Katsuragawa is 13 under at the Genesis Championship, holding a two-stroke lead going into the final day; Katsuragawa shot a flawless third-round eight-under 63 at Woo Jeong Hills Country Club; watch Sunday's final round live on Sky Sports Golf from 3am
articles.body:
Katsuragawa shot a flawless eight-under 63 in the third round at Woo Jeong Hills Country Club, including four birdies in his first five holes, to match Jinam Kang's record in 2006.

The 28-year-old is 13 under overall, two shots ahead of South Africa's Casey Jarvis.

Jarvis is seeking a third win of the 2026 season, after the Kenya Open and South African Open in February, to close in on the top three in the Race to Dubai standings - Eugenio Chacarra, Patrick Reed and Rory McIlroy.

Reed and McIlroy are not competing this week. Chacarra, who is No 1 in the standings after winning in India last week, was 10 shots back after the third round and tied for 30th.

There are two more events left in the European tour season, in Abu Dhabi and then Dubai.

Watch continued coverage of the DP World Tour's Genesis Championship, live on Sky Sports Golf on Sunday from 3am. Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW .

articles.title: Cowboys Get Stunning Dak Prescott Trade Take From Skip Bayless
articles.summary: Skip Bayless has grown frustrated with the Dallas Cowboys’ uneven start and said he would immediately swap starting quarterback Dak Prescott for Washington C...
articles.body:
Skip Bayless has grown frustrated with the Dallas Cowboys' uneven start and said he would immediately swap starting quarterback Dak Prescott for Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels.

The Cowboys sit at 2-4 after six games in the 2026 season, most recently falling 23-13 to the Green Bay Packers. Prescott has drawn criticism during the stretch, including after a 24-16 home loss to the previously winless Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Bayless, a longtime Cowboys supporter, made the remarks on the Gridiron podcast alongside Aqib Talib. He pointed to the team's results with Prescott available in recent seasons.

Skip Bayless Open to Straight-Up Dak Prescott Deal for Jayden Daniels

In the clip shared by Gridiron on X, Bayless made his opinion crystal clear.

"If they want to trade me Jayden Daniels for Dak Prescott. It's done. Straight up, player for player. Let me have him, I'll take it," Bayless said .

"He was available all last year when we went 7-9-1. He's been available this year; we're 2-4. Give me Jayden Daniels."

Daniels, in his third season, has started four games for the Commanders this year. He has completed 75 of 116 passes for 759 yards, five touchdowns and zero interceptions, posting a 97.6 passer rating. He has also rushed for 213 yards and two scores.

Prescott has started all six games for Dallas. He is 163 of 246 for 1,639 yards, 10 touchdowns and five interceptions with a 90.1 rating and 66.3 percent completion rate. The Cowboys rank sixth in the league in passing yards per game at 273.2 but sit near the bottom of the league in rushing.

The Cowboys face the Philadelphia Eagles on Monday night in Week 7. Philadelphia is also 2-4, and a Dallas victory would move the Cowboys into a tie for second in the NFC East. The New York Giants lead the division at 3-2-1, while the Commanders are 1-4-1.

Dallas finished 7-9-1 last season with Prescott under center for most of the year. Daniels, as a rookie in 2024, helped the Commanders reach the NFC Championship Game. The Cowboys have not advanced beyond the divisional round during Prescott's tenure as the full-time starter since 2016.

Prescott's recent outings include a 34-of-54, 258-yard performance with one touchdown and two interceptions against Green Bay. Against Tampa Bay he went 24 of 42 for 316 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in the loss that snapped the Buccaneers' winless streak.

The Cowboys' defense has allowed 26.5 points per game and ranks near the bottom of the league against the run. Offense has produced 25.2 points per game, but turnovers have been an issue in the losses.

Bayless has long argued that Dallas needs a different approach at quarterback after years of regular-season production without deep playoff runs.

The team remains in contention in a weak NFC East, with games remaining against Arizona, Indianapolis and others before a late-season rematch with Philadelphia.

articles.title: Booker scores 43 points in Suns' 131-122 win over Warriors, who fall to 0-3
articles.summary: PHOENIX (AP) — Devin Booker scored 43 points, Miles Bridges added 16 and the Phoenix Suns won their home opener for the fifth straight season by beating the...
articles.body:
PHOENIX (AP) — Devin Booker scored 43 points, Miles Bridges added 16 and the Phoenix Suns won their home opener for the fifth straight season by beating the short-handed Golden State Warriors 131-122 on Saturday night.

The Warriors — who were playing for the third time in four days — fell to 0-3 for the first time in 19 years while resting several key players, including Stephen Curry (right knee), Brandin Podziemski (low back), Draymond Green (low back) and Al Horford (low back).

Booker scored 17 points in the third quarter and Jordan Goodwin hit a 3-pointer just before the buzzer to give the Suns a 102-92 lead entering the fourth. The Warriors hung around for a few more minutes, but the Suns eventually pulled away and Luke Kennard hit a 3 to extend the lead to 117-102 with six minutes left.

Kennard finished with 11 points, hitting 3 of 5 from 3-point range, which is exactly what the team expected when they signed him in the offseason. Dillon Brooks had 15 points and five assists.

The Suns were coming off an embarrassing 124-83 road loss in the season opener to the Trail Blazers. They struggled in the opening quarter of Saturday's game, too, making just 1 of 12 shots from 3-point range.

But the shots finally started to fall and it was Booker who led the way. The five-time All-Star made 17 of 25 from the field and added seven assists and seven rebounds.

Golden State was led by rookie Yaxel Lendeborg, who scored a season-high 26 points and made six 3-pointers. De'Anthony Melton added 25 points on 8 of 13 shooting.

Booker scored 19 points in the first half, leading the Suns to a 57-54 halftime lead. Lendeborg had 13 for the Warriors.
